steps.text: The inn has over ten branch locations in Shangshu. Yet, they do not take the name Xingyu. Perhaps Xinglu for a journey fortunate, or Xingfu for a journey blessed—but Xingyu, for a journey plentiful, belongs to this inn alone.

And of course, this inn alone provides such an incredible view of the skyscrapers against the twin moons mirrored in the distant lake at night. The innkeeper paid mind only to the scenery when choosing locations. Not to the guests, nor to the rent.
Fine scenery puts guests in a fine mood. Fine scenery puts all in harmony, and the coin will come whether you like it or not.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Mmm... fine tea indeed, and a fine view.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: First timers should stay somewhere nice. Get a good impression of Shangshu.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Xingyu Inn. An antique, elegant name.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Famous, but it only recently got into food service. The innkeeper has talent, and whatever he touches goes well.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: It's grown to be a lot to handle, but still he...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Is that him there, busying about?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: The very same.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Doesn't look like an owner at all. Very steady as he goes. You have to admire him.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If only I knew what my old schoolmate was up to... The Liang boy.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: To borrow your words: steady as he goes.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Is he a good mandarin?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Ask any passerby, shoe-shiner, yam hawker, or taxi driver on the street. They'd all give him a thumbs-up.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Haha. Living his dream, then. Wish I could say that.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: You haven't met Mr. Liang in over ten years?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Nope.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: But he still chose you to deliver this item.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That it is.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Then your bond must deserve a thumbs-up as well.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I'm not experienced enough to say what this portends. I only know by Mr. Liang's expression that this is no laughing matter.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hardly. I wouldn't dare flaunt any grand bond with your 'Mr. Liang.' But Liang Xun, the man? He's a friend.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: A friend, you say?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And a good one.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: A good friend is hard enough to find, much less one that will stay so after ten years apart.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What about you, Master Shen?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: What about me?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: With so many ferrymen at the docks, didn't it seem strange I chose you in particular?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: No. I was briefed by Mr. Liang, so I assumed you were too. I have no need for the details.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I had to steal this thing right out of a smuggler's hands for old Mr. Liang. Took some effort.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I didn't ask. You must have been itching to speak.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I came all this way with no one to talk to. You bet I'm itchy.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'm surprised you trust Liang, what with that cold look on his face. Most people don't.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Ah. You trust him because he's your friend. I do because he's the magistrate of Shangshu.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Do you know him well?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I do. Mr. Liang is good to us, so we return the favor.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How long have you been in this business, Master Shen?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Hard to say... Who counts out the passing years on their fingers? Twenty? Thirty?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Very admirable.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I'm only a boatman, what's there to admire? Lately they've been putting engines on the boats. Maybe I'll be out of a job in a few years.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: They'll still need someone to navigate the route and keep watch on the sky. I figure as long as there are waterways and the years run long, boatmen and Catastrophe Messengers are in the same boat.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Catastrophes, you say.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: You don't see one often, but when you do, you never forget.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Have you seen one before?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I have, but also things even more frightening. Not on the rivers, mind you—wait, what have you got me saying?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Strange. Two foreigners, it seems.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Alright, two guests?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Two guests.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: So this is your 'reputation exceptional, dishes quintessential, service congenial, treatment all-equal' Xingyu Inn, then?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But of course, but of course. My master had nothing but praise for the 'Xingyu' name, so while I've never been graced with a chance to visit Shangshu, I just had to take you here, benefactor.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Ah, but...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Heh, it shames me to admit, but my master praised only the name, not any particular amenity. So I am also ignorant as to its precise forte.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Here's your tea.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Just refreshments, or will you two be needing lodging too?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Wow, they've even got the standard line, huh?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Hey, listen here. Maybe we've only been open for a few years, but trace the name 'Xingyu' back and you'll see it's got a century's worth of fame.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor, we've been searching for lodging, the prices are suitable enough, and it's not far from the northern crossing we agreed to meet at. What say you?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I'm fine with whatever.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Then two rooms, please.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Allllright then. Anything to eat for now?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: May I ask what you have?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Our recommended set meals are on the signs. We're currently on the afternoon menu. If you need anything, just shout.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Very well, let's see...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: This one looks alright, mate. Lot of Yan flavor in that name.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: The extra-spicy fowl blood curd set...? I'd recommend refraining for now.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Why? When in Londinium, right? Can't hurt to try.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: In my experience, such dishes don't quite... mesh with the lunchtime sensibilities a Rim Billitonian such as yourself might be accustomed to.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That so? I think I'm pretty good with spice, myself.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What are you sneaking peeks at?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Look there, at the proprietor. The innkeeper, I wager.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What about him?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: He's a force to be reckoned with.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: A force how?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Of course, he has to be, with a business this grand. But there's something more than that...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Are those calluses on his hands?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Your vision is as astounding as ever, benefactor!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: And there's been two guests on the floor upstairs eyeing us ever since we walked in.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: What part of them's caught your eye?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well... that Cautus seems oddly familiar...

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Are you staying here today, boss? Not heading to check out the other side of the crossing?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: No, I'm expecting someone. I must be here to attend to this guest.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Heh, you're offering personal service? Gotta be a big shot then. Are we open for business then? How much can we make?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: There might not be money in it. No shortage of things to settle, though.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Is it about the business over there?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Yes and no.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: What does THAT mean?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Less blabbering, more greeting the customers.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Pssh, penny-pincher.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Ai, welcome, guests, are you—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Miss Du? What are you—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: None of your business. Out of the way.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Why—what a formidable greeting, young lady. Are you looking for me?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: A sloppy man with glasses, a gaudy outfit, and the look of a swindler.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: So it's gotta be you, right?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Er... I must say that appraisal is a little...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: An enemy of yours?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: No, they'd never go so far as to send a little girl to do their bidding...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Who's a little girl, huh?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (She kicked up an entire wooden chair—what leg technique!)

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hmph. You have quick reflexes, dodging without getting up.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Miss, Miss!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What? Can't you see I'm busy—

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: This guy's a Liberi, right? Didn't the letter say we were looking for a Lung?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Then it's the one upstairs. It's you, right, isn't it?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Hey now, don't I deserve at least an apology?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Cool it, mate... Hm?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Personally, I thought my attire was just dandy.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Given her approach, I doubt she means well.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You stroll in and abuse an innocent chair, not to mention almost giving that man a concussion for no reason.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Give it up, your cover's blown. Now play nice and hand it over.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hmph. I'll grant that it takes guts to sneak into the city in broad daylight though.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Miss Du, was it? I believe there might be a misunderstanding.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Did you come from Lungmen?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Er, yes.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Are you carrying an antique wine cup with you?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Then you have one minute to think up a good excuse. After that, you're handing it over and coming with me.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The young lady's not too keen on hearing people out... Really makes me miss those kids of mine back home. They'd know better.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Don't look at me. Mr. Liang explained that he specifically entrusted you with bringing that wine cup from Lungmen.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: And if Mr. Liang says so, I believe it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, Master Shen, thanks for the vote of confidence.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Odd though... This girl's bold enough to openly say she wants something that Mr. Liang requested?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: One of our aunties plucked this right from a child smuggler's hands, so if you were expecting any legal formalities... haha.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Is the cup noteworthy?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I looked into it, there's only baseless legends. Rumors the smugglers heard from the locals.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: *Sigh*. How did this become such a hassle?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Nothing, mate, I've seen this in a movie before!)

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (As have I! But they'd usually call the officers at this point. They'd never jump into a fight, right...?)

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hey, enough muttering! Got your excuse ready?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (The lady is certainly blessed with a loud voice... Might those two upstairs be suspects of a sort, then?)

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (Benefactor?)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Mate. I... I think that guy looks familiar.)

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (What? The fellow with the remarkably similar get-up to mine?)

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (No... It can't be... They work with Rhodes Island. Guess there's a little resemblance though?)

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How about this, young lady? You've caught me, fair and square. Nowhere to run. Now, if you'd call the police...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Stalling for time, huh? Alright. I was wondering how long you could anyway.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Get up there!

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Don't let him get away!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: A moment, please!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What, you want to pay me back for earlier?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Stand down, let me finish my business, and I'll pay for two days of lodging, all expenses. Sound good?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Take a good, long look Benefactor. If we've not got the wrong person, then a wonderful opportunity has landed in our laps.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Mr. Lee...?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Let's see... little blonde rabbit, ambiguously closed eyes... a Rhodes Island operator?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Miraculous. Of the taverns in Shangshu, in all of Yan, in all the world, to think you'd have the fortune to run into an old friend here.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: So how about we not sour the mood on this miraculous reunion?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What the hell is going on?! You're all together?!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Surround them! Nobody leaves until they hand over the booty!
Oh? What inspired this?
I dreamt of the fable of the shadow's shadow counseling its shade, and this is my response.
Then I'd like to see it. How do you plan to let these common objects manifest themselves?
Take it as but an inadvertent act. Mock me not for it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What the... just now...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor, watch out!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: They're all civvies. Keep a light touch.

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Careful, that Liberi's from some martial school! Leave the Cautus to me—huh? Where'd she go?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Why's it always punch first, ask questions later...?

steps.name: Street Youth
steps.text: Wh-When did she get on the second floor?!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No need to hurt anyone, Nothing, mate. Easy does it.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Over here, Mr. Lee.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: *Sigh* So sorry to get you all caught up in this mess.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Not like we expected to run into you, Mr. Lee. Well, uh, let's get out of here first.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hey—! Are you ignoring me on purpose?! You think you can just leave?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Apologies, but you won't be passing.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: And who're you to decide?!

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: A fan? That swindler... uh, no, that guest knows some rare kung fu, doesn't he?

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Zheng? Sir? Shouldn't you step in before they ruin all the furniture on the ground floor?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: Fan man's moves are probably meant to intimidate. He's being very slick about it. But the lady hasn't shown us everything yet either. If they work things out, we all come out richer and happier.

steps.name: Inn Assistant
steps.text: While she's still being cautious, at least.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: All you fine people!
In the late evenings of Shangshu's early spring, the wind arrives on time while the rain is no guarantee. So it has always been.
A man lifts his head to the skies. The clouds and mist furl, Hui and Ming waver, but at the furthest ends, one can faintly see the light of day.
A spring chill hangs, and a light breeze flutters their clothes.

steps.name: Unfrivolous Man
steps.text: He should be here by now.

steps.name: Unfrivolous Man
steps.text: I do hope that things conclude smoothly.
